fato_historico: 1993: North Macedonia's deadliest aviation disaster occurs when Avioimpex Flight 110, a Yakovlev Yak-42, crashes near Ohrid Airport, killing all 116 people on board.
energia_do_dia: Today may invite you to reflect on the fragility of life and the strength of the human spirit. Much like a phoenix rising, consider how your own inner resilience can turn past challenges into wisdom. It is a good time to cherish your connections and find beauty in the quiet moments that ground your ambitious heart.
frase_do_dia: Every sunrise offers a fresh path to nurture your soul and dreams.
significado_numero: A powerful number representing spiritual intuition and inner illumination.
conselho: Prioritize kindness today and hold your loved ones closer than usual.
